## `FilterDirection` {#model-extension-filterdirection}

| value | description |
| --- | --- |
| `one_to_many` | Selections flow from the one side to the many side (plan D5): a selected region filters orders, a selected order status doesn't filter customers. The default. |
| `both` | Selections flow both ways (plan §5.4): a selected order status also narrows customers to those with such orders, and everything associated with them. Relationships may not form a loop. |
